UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User account profile, active account pointer, and relocation preferences

id.description: User unique identifier matching auth UID

activeAccountId.description: Currently active custom User ID or persona ID

monthlyBudgetUSD.description: Expected monthly retirement budget in USD

aboutMe.description: Detailed background story and retirement vision

signupNumber.description: Registration sequence rank number (e.g. 1 for first member)

badges.description: Earned profile honors and badges (Globetrotter, Polyglot, Early Pioneer)

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last profile update

SavedUserAccount.title: SavedUserAccount
SavedUserAccount.description: Custom created user ID account record and profile snapshot persisted in Firestore

id.description: Custom User ID or generated account identifier

name.description: Display name for this user account

email.description: Email address associated with this user account

profile.description: Complete UserProfile data for this User ID

checklist.description: Relocation checklist tasks specific to this User ID

CountryJournalEntry.title: CountryJournalEntry
CountryJournalEntry.description: Private country journal note and interest tracking entry for a user

accountId.description: Optional custom User ID this journal entry belongs to

privateNotes.description: Private expat journal notes, questions, and research findings

tags.description: Quick custom or preset tags for this destination

scoutingTimeline.description: Planned trip or scouting visit window

personalBudgetEstimateUSD.description: Custom projected monthly budget in USD

visitedBefore.description: Whether the user has physically visited this country

isFavorited.description: Whether the user has bookmarked or favorited this country

UserWorkspaceDoc.title: UserWorkspaceDoc
UserWorkspaceDoc.description: Synced workspace collections (community threads, meetups, direct messages, and custom country data)

FeedbackReport.title: FeedbackReport
FeedbackReport.description: User feedback and bug report submissions with FIRE realism answers, missing data points, status tracking, and provider contact information

isRegisteredUser.description: Whether the provider is an authenticated registered expat member

userEmail.description: Email address of provider for follow-up

fireNumbersRating.description: Answer to FIRE numbers realistic question

fireNumbersComment.description: Specific comments on FIRE calculations and cost numbers

missingDataPoint.description: Answer to what country or data point is missing

bugStepsToReproduce.description: Steps to reproduce the reported bug

currentUrlOrView.description: Page or route where the feedback was initiated

deviceInfo.description: Browser user agent and device summary

adminNotes.description: Internal administrative notes and response logs

resolvedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the ticket was resolved

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last status update

ScoutTrip.title: ScoutTrip
ScoutTrip.description: Multi-stop sabbatical and relocation scouting trip itinerary with Schengen allowance tracking, living burn calculation, relocation tasks, and packing vault

stops.description: List of 1 to 5 country stops with arrival/departure dates, visa tags, and burn rates

tasks.description: Relocation tasks and bucket list experiences

accommodation.description: Accommodation snapshot with property name, dates, host contact/code, and booking link

packingList.description: Smart packing checklist items split into travel essentials and relocation documents

selectedItineraryItems.description: User-selected places, venues, operators, and activities scheduled by week and day

selectedInterests.description: Selected personal interest category IDs for the scouting trip

customHobbies.description: Custom hobbies and passions entered by the user

totalDays.description: Total duration of the scouting trip in days

schengenDays.description: Total days spent in European Schengen zone countries

estimatedTotalBurnUSD.description: Estimated total living burn in USD across all stops

PlatformThemeConfig.title: PlatformThemeConfig
PlatformThemeConfig.description: Global platform typography and theme configuration managed exclusively by administrators and applied to all visitors

displayCss.description: CSS font-family value for headings and display text

bodyCss.description: CSS font-family value for body and UI controls

monoCss.description: CSS font-family value for numeric telemetry and badges

updatedBy.description: Admin email or UID who saved the setting

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last global save

PlatformBadgesConfig.title: PlatformBadgesConfig
PlatformBadgesConfig.description: Global badge thresholds and configuration such as Early Pioneer cutoff, managed by administrators and publicly readable

earlyPioneerThreshold.description: Maximum registered user count threshold for the Early Pioneer badge (default 100)

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last configuration update

updatedBy.description: Admin identifier who updated the threshold

/platformSettings/{settingId}.description: Global platform configuration (such as live website typography) readable by all visitors and writable strictly by administrators

/feedbackReports/{reportId}.description: Global collection for user feedback and bug submissions

/users/{userId}.description: Root users collection storing all User IDs (usr-ganesh, usr-elena, usr-marcus, custom IDs) and primary auth session document

/savedAccounts/{accountId}.description: Top-level collection storing all registered User IDs and full expat profiles

/countryJournals/{countryId}.description: Top-level collection storing private country journal notes and interest ratings

/communityThreads/{threadId}.description: Top-level collection storing community forum discussion threads and comments

/expatMeetups/{meetupId}.description: Top-level collection storing expat meetups and RSVP status

/relocationChecklists/{accountId}.description: Top-level collection storing relocation readiness checklists per User ID

/users/{userId}/savedAccounts/{accountId.description: Subcollection storing all custom User IDs and expat profiles created by the user

/users/{userId}/journalEntries/{countryI.description: Private subcollection containing individual country journal records and interest tracking

/users/{userId}/workspace/{docId}.description: Subcollection storing synced community threads, meetups, messages, and country customizations

/users/{userId}/trips/{tripId}.description: Subcollection storing user scouting trip itineraries, Schengen visa allowances, relocation tasks, and packing checklists
